Rising domestic institutional allocation to tech equities, as seen in the ALERT signal, reflects a structural shift away from commodity-linked sectors toward high-growth digital assets.
sectors.ai: Buy Indonesia tech on the ALERT signal: local names are outperforming US peers (+1.85% vs +0.61%), with heavyweights like IRSX and PMUI leading. The signal confirms a durable rotation into domestic digital infrastructure and e-commerce. Add exposure now; momentum is broad-based and not yet overextended.

US-linked VRT/ETN offer AI-data-center upside but lag ID returns; rotate into local winners before the signal flips to BUY. Trim PACK/LEAD if they fail to hold gains by week's close.
